auth.label: Development API Key
auth.description: Yuanfenju development API key. Register or sign in at https://portal.yuanfenju.com/ and copy the Development Key from your merchant account. Calls use your account's plan and quota; tarot readings require paid membership.

actions.name: analyze_bazi_compatibility
actions.description: Analyze two people's Bazi charts for relationship or marriage entertainment using the official matching interface selected by the caller. Marriage uses firstPerson as the male partner and secondPerson as the female partner. Each lunar date in 1900-2100 adds a conversion call; other non-leap lunar dates use native input.

scenario.description: The matching scenario: relationship for general matching or marriage for the traditional male/female marriage interface. Defaults to relationship.

name.description: The name displayed on the chart.

calendarType.description: The input calendar. Defaults to solar (Gregorian).

month.description: The input month. Negative values represent lunar leap months, such as -6 for leap June.

minute.description: The minute. Defaults to 0 when unknown.

firstPerson.description: The first person's birth details; in the marriage scenario this is the male partner.

name.description: The name displayed on the chart.

calendarType.description: The input calendar. Defaults to solar (Gregorian).

month.description: The input month. Negative values represent lunar leap months, such as -6 for leap June.

minute.description: The minute. Defaults to 0 when unknown.

secondPerson.description: The second person's birth details; in the marriage scenario this is the female partner.

scoringMode.description: The scoring mode: traditional binary scoring or graded flexible scoring (recommended and the connector default).

language.description: The result language: simplified Chinese, traditional Chinese or English.

inputSchema.description: The two people and scoring options for Bazi compatibility.

male.description: The provider's first-person chart, under its native male field.

female.description: The provider's second-person chart, under its native female field.

all_score.description: The overall matching score returned by the provider.

master_evaluation.description: The provider's combined evaluation and entertainment interpretation.

analysis.description: The complete matching scores, two charts and interpretations returned for the selected scenario.

anyOf.description: The provider's cultural research and entertainment notice.

notice.description: The provider's cultural research and entertainment notice.

actions.name: convert_calendar

year.description: The year to convert, from 1900 to 2100.

month.description: The input month. Negative values represent lunar leap months, such as -6 for leap June.

hour.description: The hour to convert. Defaults to 0.

second.description: The second to convert. Defaults to 0.

actions.name: get_bazi_chart
actions.description: Calculate a standard Bazi chart with four pillars, five elements and luck cycles for cultural research and entertainment. Lunar dates in 1900-2100 are converted first, including leap months, using an additional API call. Other non-leap lunar dates use native lunar input.

name.description: The name displayed on the chart.

sex.description: The sex used by the provider's traditional chart calculation.

calendarType.description: The input calendar. Defaults to solar (Gregorian).

month.description: The input month. Negative values represent lunar leap months, such as -6 for leap June.

minute.description: The minute. Defaults to 0 when unknown.

sect.description: The late Zi-hour convention: 1 uses the next day's pillar; 2 uses the same day (default).

trueSolarTime.description: The true solar time mode: none (default), china using province/city, or global using coordinates/timezone.

province.description: The Chinese province required for china true solar time.

city.description: The Chinese city required for china true solar time. Use the official Yuanfenju place names.

longitude.description: The longitude required for global true solar time, with at most six decimal places.

latitude.description: The latitude required for global true solar time, with at most six decimal places.

timezone.description: The birth location IANA timezone for global true solar time. Defaults to Asia/Shanghai.

language.description: The result language: simplified or traditional Chinese.

inputSchema.description: The birth details for a standard Bazi chart.

base_info.description: The birth details, chart classification and five-element analysis.

detail_info.description: The four pillars, childhood period and major/yearly luck cycles.

chart.description: The complete standard Bazi chart, including all provider-defined fields.

anyOf.description: The provider's cultural research and entertainment notice.

notice.description: The provider's cultural research and entertainment notice.

actions.name: get_natal_chart
actions.description: Calculate a Western astrology natal chart from the original Gregorian local birth time for cultural research and entertainment. Returns celestial data, official interpretations and the SVG chart when provided. The provider handles timezone/DST and transport compression; no true solar time correction is applied.

minute.description: The minute. Defaults to 0 when unknown.

sex.description: The sex used by the provider's traditional chart calculation.

longitude.description: The birth longitude, at most six decimal places. If omitted, the provider uses Beijing longitude.

latitude.description: The birth latitude, at most six decimal places. If omitted, the provider uses Beijing latitude.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone of the original local birth time. Defaults to Asia/Shanghai; the provider handles historical daylight saving time.

houseSystem.description: The house system code. Defaults to P (Placidus).

additionalObjects.description: Additional celestial objects: 1 Vertex, 2 Chiron, 3 Ceres, 4 Pallas, 5 Juno, 6 Vesta, 7 Part of Fortune, 8 true Node, 9 mean Lilith, 10 Psyche, 11 Eros, 12 Haumea, 13 Eris, 14 Makemake, 15 mean Node, 16 south Node.

orbModel.description: The aspect orb model: strict, standard (default), wide or custom.

conjunction.description: The conjunction orb (0-degree aspect). The official default is 8 degrees.

semisextile.description: The semisextile orb (30-degree aspect). The official default is 2 degrees.

sextile.description: The sextile orb (60-degree aspect). The official default is 6 degrees.

square.description: The square orb (90-degree aspect). The official default is 6 degrees.

trine.description: The trine orb (120-degree aspect). The official default is 6 degrees.

quincunx.description: The quincunx orb (150-degree aspect). The official default is 3 degrees.

opposition.description: The opposition orb (180-degree aspect). The official default is 8 degrees.

customOrbs.description: Custom aspect orbs in degrees, used only with orbModel=custom. Omitted values use the official defaults.

language.description: The result language: simplified Chinese, traditional Chinese or English.

inputSchema.description: The Gregorian birth details and Western astrology chart options. Use the original local time, not true solar time.

base_info.description: The natal chart's birth details and calculation settings.

chart_data.description: The houses, celestial objects, aspects, statistics and chart patterns.

chart_description.description: The official natal chart interpretations in the requested language.

chart_svg.description: The SVG chart source returned by the provider.

detail_info.description: The celestial data, official interpretations and SVG chart.

chart.description: The full natal chart returned by Yuanfenju.

anyOf.description: The provider's cultural research and entertainment notice.

notice.description: The provider's cultural research and entertainment notice.

outputSchema.description: The Western astrology natal chart result.
